subject: Quick follow-up: Nimbus Health discovery — next steps & timing

Subject: Quick follow-up: Nimbus Health discovery — next steps & timing

Hi Samantha / Carlos,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the candid overview of your inference pain points and regulatory constraints. Quick summary + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Discovery recap (high level)
- Workload: mixed real-time triage + nightly batch scoring; median prompt length ~60 tokens, occasional long-context cases (~2k).
- Key constraints: PHI handling, SOC2 + HIPAA controls, EU data residency for some lines of business.
- Targets: target P99 latency < 500ms for triage; predictable monthly unit cost for budget planning.
- Success metric: pilot with 1 app in production for 90 days and latency/cost within agreed SLOs.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) SE deep-dive (30–45m) — technical architecture, sample payloads, and baseline perf expectations (Priyom).
2) SOC2/HIPAA evidence pack — share high-level artifacts (we have a summary attached).
3) Pilot proposal — three-month pilot on Dedicated capacity with measured SLOs and a joint runbook (I’ll draft).

Timing ask
- If pilot is still Q2 priority, we can start SE deep-dive next week and share a draft MA plan by end of week.
- If timing moved, let me know new window and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: discovery-notes-nimbus.pdf (summary notes), soc2-evidence-summary.pdf

I’ll loop SE and CS on timing — Priyom/Marissa, are you available for a technical call next Tue/Wed?

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Checking in on pricing + SE deep-dive scheduling

Hi Samantha — wanted to bump this up on your radar. Per your ask, I can share a simple cost band: 

- Hosted API (pay-as-you-go): estimated $0.012–$0.025 per token-equivalent depending on model family and latency SLOs.
- Dedicated (reserved pools for pilot): estimated $8k–$20k/month depending on GPU class and instance sizing for your target throughput.
- Pilot (3 months Dedicated + onboarding): typical starting commitment for pilots we run is ~$25k–$60k total with a short-term pilot discount.

These are rough ranges — Priyom and I will refine once we size the model variant and concurrency. Does Wed 14th 2pm PT still work for the SE call?

If priorities shifted, tell me and I’ll pause outreach.

Thanks,
Jonas

- Technical posture: given PHI / SOC2 / EU residency, do we lead with Dedicated + Private control plane or offer hosted as an initial quick win?
- Offer: I’m thinking a 3-month pilot on Dedicated with a small onboarding credit (20% off) conditional on a short-term commit. Is that ok from a pricing floor standpoint?
- CS involvement: Marissa, we’ll need a CSM intro and a basic kickoff checklist if they sign the pilot.

Attached: nimbus-proposed-ma-plan.xlsx (draft pilot pricing and milestones). Thoughts? I’d like to send a short re-engagement note that is both helpful and shows momentum — not a hard close.

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas / team — quick technical read:

- Given PHI and EU residency ask, recommend we lead with Dedicated + VPC/private control plane for the pilot. Hosted adds complexity for legal/contracting and likely slows procurement.
- Model selection: start with a quantized 8-bit open decoder for latency/cost tradeoff; estimate we can meet P99 < 500ms with S4/8 GPUs at expected concurrency, but we should validate with representative payloads.
- Pilot scope: 3-month Dedicated pilot with a single model variant + option to expand to a fallback smaller model for cost-sensitive endpoints.
- Security artifacts: I can assemble the technical mapping for SOC2 + HIPAA (what we can share) and a short runbook for data handling.

Pricing/discount guidance: engineering is fine with a modest onboarding discount for a pilot (15-25%). For anything >30% I’d want leadership sign-off.

I can join the customer SE call on Wed 14th 2pm PT and demo a quick perf sketch.

— Priyom
